faqs.q: Sec. 78-67. - Approval of method of sale; sale price generally.
faqs.a:
(a)
Any bonds issued pursuant hereto shall be sold in such manner as may be approved by
               the council to defray the cost of the project, including without limitation, any temporary
               advances therefor and all proper incidental expenses.
(b)
Bonds shall be sold to the highest and best bidder for cash and to the best advantage
               of the city at, above, or below par.
(Code 1981, § 27-68; Ord. No. 551, § 25(B), (C), 5-14-1964; Ord. No. 1643, § 4, 2-18-1980;
               Ord. No. 2294, § 4, 7-7-1986)
